# Maths for Data Science - cohort control repo

This is the **`.github` repo** for the `hertie-maths-data-science-f2026` cohort org. **Students and instructors rarely need to touch anything in this repo directly.**

Built and kept in sync by the [DSL teaching toolkit](https://github.com/hertie-data-science-lab/dsl-teaching-toolkit).
